packet: Packet 7 — Place-Centered Dataset Context & Maritime Connectivity

ethical_compliance.verification_note: Dataset context is derived purely from vessel voyage endpoint metadata (TODOSNAVIOS). No enslaved persons or cargo lines are commercialized or quantified.

exception_queue.subject: place_st_domingo (Saint-Domingue / Santo Domingo)
exception_queue.summary: Place unmapped pending historical adjudication between colonial French Saint-Domingue and Spanish Santo Domingo.
exception_queue.finding: Published status is unmapped with periods: null and neutral unavailable caveat. Zero Crespo records published. Preserved as exception queue entry without speculative mapping.

analytical_derivation_contracts.title: Crespo TODOSNAVIOS record aggregation per place and period preset
analytical_derivation_contracts.derivation_method: Relational aggregation on raw_todosnavios filtered by date ranges and mapped Lugar IDs
analytical_derivation_contracts.verification_invariant: Baseline total matches 1,928 scoped records (1650–1730); exact counts match per place.

analytical_derivation_contracts.title: Endpoint role classification (departure vs arrival)
analytical_derivation_contracts.derivation_method: Counting voyage occurrences as origin (records_with_origin) versus destination (records_with_destination)
analytical_derivation_contracts.verification_invariant: Non-negative integers for records_with_origin and records_with_destination.

analytical_derivation_contracts.title: Dual-endpoint overlap and union arithmetic
analytical_derivation_contracts.derivation_method: Set intersection of origin and destination within single voyage record (both_endpoint_records)
analytical_derivation_contracts.verification_invariant: total_records == records_with_origin + records_with_destination - both_endpoint_records; Cádiz overlap = 24 records.

analytical_derivation_contracts.title: Directed counterpart pair ranking with self-counterpart exclusion
analytical_derivation_contracts.derivation_method: Frequency ranking of opposite-endpoint Lugar IDs strictly excluding the examined place's own Lugar ID
analytical_derivation_contracts.verification_invariant: Examined place never appears in its own top_counterparts list.

analytical_derivation_contracts.title: Canonical place mapping lookup and unmapped sentinel handling
analytical_derivation_contracts.derivation_method: Explicit YAML lookup with 19 mapped and 10 unmapped places; unmapped places emit periods: null and neutral unavailable copy
analytical_derivation_contracts.verification_invariant: Audit confirms exactly 19 mapped, 10 unmapped places; unmapped places have periods: null; no synthetic zeroes.

place_mapping_review.unmapped_sentinels_summary: 10 canonical places unmapped in Crespo dataset (including Port Royal, Nevis, Dartmouth, Saint-Domingue). Emitted with periods: null.

garrote_lookback.subject: Maestre Bartolomé Garrote (11357)
garrote_lookback.summary: Occurrence-level probable match preserved from Packet 6 without regressions or unreviewed identity promotions.
